title: Parse boolean settings correctly
requirement:
config.get_bool(env, key, default=False) uses bool(env.get(key)), so 'false' and '0' are True. Accept
'1', 'true', 'yes', 'on' as True and '0', 'false', 'no', 'off' as False (case-insensitive, surrounding
whitespace ignored). A missing key returns default; any other value raises ValueError naming the key.
